item.title: Philippines, USA Looking to Expand Cooperation on Energy Security
item.description: The Philippines and the U.S. are exploring an expansion of collaboration on energy security, according to Manila's energy department.

item.title: Vår Energi, Equinor find gas and condensate at Lakris prospect
item.description: Vår Energi and its partner Equinor have made a gas and condensate discovery at the Lakris prospect in the Gimsan Basin on the Halten Terrace in the Norwegian Sea.

item.title: Brazil will drill: why a global transition leader is set on oil and gas expansion
item.description: Brazil leads in clean energy but – whether Lula or Bolsonaro wins – the next government will charge ahead with oil and gas expansion.

item.title: EIA Sees Smaller Oil Crunch in 2026
item.description: The U.S. Energy Information Administration tightened its oil crunch prediction for 2026 in its latest short term energy outlook.

item.title: Europa Oil & Gas secures 12-month EG-08 licence extension
item.description: Europa Oil & Gas has been granted a 12-month extension to the first exploration sub-period of its offshore EG-08 block in Equatorial Guinea, moving the deadline from 4 October 2026 to 4 October 2027.

item.title: NG Energy starts production at Aruchara-6 well in Colombia
item.description: Canada-based gas producer NG Energy International (NGE) has brought the Aruchara-6 well into production at Maria Conchita Block, with drilling also under way at Sinú-9 block in Colombia.

item.title: Trump Says Diesel Deal Aims to Keep Russia Talks Going
item.description: President Donald Trump said he cut a diesel export deal with Russia and delayed imposing further sanctions because he doesn't want to drive Vladimir Putin away from peace talks.

item.title: Venezuela Sees Nearly $76B Oil Investment Over 5 Years
item.description: Venezuela expects almost $76 billion of investment in its oil and gas sector over the next five years, Acting President Delcy Rodriguez said Saturday.
